---
name: Question to predict
about: A training question that is not yet a problem folder
labels: question
---

**What number would a formula predict?** (one measurable quantity, for example "final loss" or "share of facts kept")

**Model families:** (llm, cifar, mnist, world models, ...)

**Why someone would use the answer:** (one sentence)

**Runs that exist or are planned:** (a problem folder needs at least 200 runs)

**Floor:** (error between two runs of the same setting, if known)

**Baseline formula:** (the published law or simplest guess it must beat)
